units.source_text: 他时常有信给明石姬，劝她早日入京。

en.t: He often sent letters to the Lady of Akashi, urging her to come to the capital soon.

units.source_text: 但明石姬自知身份低微，未敢冒昧。

en.t: But the Lady of Akashi knew her own lowly status and did not dare to presume.

units.source_text: 她想：“听说京中身份高贵之人，公子对她们也不即不离，

en.t: She thought, "I hear that even with noble ladies in the capital, the gentleman keeps them neither close nor distant,

units.source_text: 似爱非爱，反而教她们增加痛苦。

en.t: seeming to love them yet not truly loving them, and only makes their suffering grow.

units.source_text: 我身上究有多少恩宠，胆敢入京参与其列呢？

en.t: How much favor could I possibly have, that I should dare go to the capital and join their ranks?

units.source_text: 我倘入京，只能显示我身的微贱，教这孩子丢脸而已。

en.t: If I went to the capital, I would only reveal my own humble station and bring shame on this child.

units.source_text: 料想他的降临一定难得，我在那里专诚等候，给人耻笑，难免弄得老大没趣。”

en.t: His visits would surely be rare, and if I waited there for him with all my heart, people would laugh at me, and I would end up bitterly humiliated."
She was deeply troubled in her heart.

units.source_text: 但又转念：倘教这孩子从此做个乡下姑娘，不得同别人一样享受富贵，也太委屈了她。

en.t: But then she thought again: if she let this child remain a country girl from now on, unable to enjoy rank and wealth like others, that would be far too unfair to her.

units.source_text: 因此她又不敢埋怨公子而断然拒绝。

en.t: For that reason, she did not dare resent the gentleman and flatly refuse him.
